mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months indicates the Federal Reserve is easing policy, lowering discount rates and increasing equity present value, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite FEDFUNDS declines, or 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances despite FEDFUNDS declines, or 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
